o.text: Borrowed from Russian аккордео́н (akkordeón), ultimately from French accordéon.
A derivation of iç (“inner part, interior”) + -əri. Cognate with Turkish içeri.
From çat (“a crack”) + -la. Of onomatopoeic origin, see çırtlamaq. Cognate to Turkish çatlamak.
